what: A four-track groovebox: Plaits' 24 models, a 16-pad kit, a step sequencer with p-locks, trig conditions and FILL, nine generative sources (Game of Life, chord progressions, Tonnetz walks, orbits, bytebeat, an improviser that learns from you...), PRINT a generative loop into steps, live transposition, Euclidean rhythms, two LFOs per track, latchable punch-in effects, undo, four projects backed up over USB and an animated scene on every page.
author: f0nski
